name: chartsy
description: Live SaaS revenue and growth analytics for AI agents: MRR, churn, revenue, refunds, at-risk customers, goals, site traffic and signups from Stripe, Paddle, Polar, Lemon Squeezy, Creem, Freemius and custom sources. Bundles the chartsy skill and the hosted, read-only Chartsy MCP server.

chartsy.description: Official Chartsy MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP, read-only). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection: Gemini CLI opens a browser to sign in to Chartsy; no token or local install required.
